overview:
**Fire danger remains High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by dry fuels — ERC at 78% and a Burning Index at 64%.**
- Danger stays High all week (through July 31), with ERC easing slightly to 72–76% and BI holding 60–69%.
- Light ENE-to-NE winds (5–8 mph) and highs in the upper 70s continue, with scattered afternoon shower/thunderstorm chances easing fuel dryness slightly.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is posted for this area today.
